**STEP 1 - Scene:** A snack or light meal of almonds, strawberries, broccoli and a mandarin, photographed from directly above.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** A square white plate, about 24 cm per side. Area is about 576 cm². The mandarin is about 6.5 cm across, which fits this scale.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Almonds (about 40), strawberry pieces (two halves and one wedge), broccoli florets, one whole mandarin. No oil or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Almonds about 15% (86 cm²), strawberries about 10% (58 cm²), broccoli about 12% (69 cm²), mandarin about 6% (33 cm²). Total about 43% of the plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Almonds 86 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 103 ml. Strawberries 58 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 87 ml. Broccoli 69 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 172 ml. The mandarin is a whole fruit, so it is sized by its ~6.5 cm diameter (about 144 ml as a sphere) rather than by the area formula.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Almonds 103 ml × 0.5 ≈ 50 g. Strawberries 87 ml × 0.6 ≈ 52 g. Broccoli 172 ml × 0.2 ≈ 30 g. Mandarin is weighed as a whole fruit at about 85 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds 50 g × 579 kcal/100 g ≈ 290 kcal. Strawberries 52 g × 32 ≈ 17 kcal. Broccoli 30 g × 34 ≈ 10 kcal. Mandarin 85 g × 53 ≈ 45 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 217 g and ≈ 362 kcal. That is plausible for about 40 almonds, three strawberry pieces, a small handful of broccoli and one mandarin, and it is well below a full dinner plate.
